$description: ProxyFlow design tokens (W3C Design Tokens format). Brand inputs from the M1 brief: navy #14243A, teal #20B8A5, light background #F6F8FB, dark background #101820. Role colours are derived so every text/icon pair meets WCAG 2.2 AA; see design/tokens/contrast-report.md (generated by design/tools/check_contrast.py).

teal.$description: Brand teal (brief). 2.33:1 on the light background: never use for text or thin UI on light surfaces; use as a large fill with navy content (6.30:1) or as primary in dark theme (7.21:1).

teal700.$description: Derived: same hue as brand teal, lightness 0.28. 4.89:1 on the light background, 5.20:1 under white text.
